items.title: Redesigned session chooser
items.text: The Cmd-Shift-N chooser is now a master–detail layout showing your live sessions with richer labels, plus a Kill action to end a session directly from the list.

items.title: Native banner checkboxes & aligned lists
items.text: Task-list checkboxes (`[x]`/`[ ]`) now render as real native boxes, and bullet, numbered, and checkbox items in a banner all line up on a shared gutter.

items.title: More resilient session persistence
items.text: After a crash, windows orphaned from their sessions are now recovered from the agent's authoritative layout, so your panes come back correctly.

items.title: Crash fix
items.text: Fixed a use-after-free during surface teardown that could crash the app when closing panes or windows.
